description: This Java class provides JSON deserialization functionality for command response objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles extracting common fields such as response type and HTTP status code and facilitates the creation of specific command response instances via a factory method.

classes.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A generic final class to deserialize JSON data into CommandResponse objects, handling type validation and HTTP status extraction.

classes.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer.FactoryMethodFunction
classes.description: A functional interface defining a factory method for creating CommandResponse instances from an HTTP status code.

methods.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the deserializer with a command response type and either a JSON object or JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Performs partial deserialization and invokes a factory method to create the specific CommandResponse instance, validating the response type and HTTP status.

methods.name: validateCommandResponseType
methods.description: Checks if the JSON object's type matches the expected command response type, throwing an exception if not.
